subject: Post-demo: Trial ops playbook & API handshake for ZephyrAI POC
messages:
From: Eleanor Ruiz <eleanor.ruiz@zephyrai.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@zephyrai.com>
Date: 2027-11-16T17:12:00-05:00
Subject: Post-demo: Trial ops playbook & API handshake for ZephyrAI POC

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo today. Tom and I walked through the streaming + tool-calling capabilities and we think Redwood could be a good fit for our annotation-assist workflow. We want to run a short, focused trial to validate latency and end-to-end cost at our expected load patterns.

Top asks from our side to scope the trial:
- A short ops/playbook that documents what you need from our infra (networking, egress, keys).
- Clear success criteria for quality, latency (p50/p95), and cost targets.
- Example SDK/API routes and a minimal integration checklist so our eng team can onboard quickly.
- A proposed timeline (2–4 week cadence) with milestones.

Can you send a recommended trial plan and list who from Redwood would own the different pieces? Also, we have an initial SOC 2 question set; I’ll loop security after we align on the plan.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—Eleanor
Eleanor Ruiz
Head of Product
ZephyrAI
E: eleanor.ruiz@zephyrai.com
T: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Eleanor Ruiz <eleanor.ruiz@zephyrai.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@zephyrai.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-16T19:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial ops playbook & API handshake for ZephyrAI POC

Eleanor — great meeting, thanks for the clear asks. Attached are two starter artifacts: a one-page success metrics template (trial-success-metrics.xlsx) and an SDK integration checklist (redwood-sdk-integration-checklist.md). High-level proposal below; we can refine on a kickoff call.

Summary trial ops/playbook (proposed):
1) Duration & milestones
   - Week 0: Kickoff, creds + sandbox access, baseline latency tests.
   - Week 1: Integration (SDK routes + streaming ingest), smoke tests, quick quality spot-checks.
   - Week 2: Load run at target QPS, cost sampling, end-to-end quality evaluation.
   - Week 3: Wrap / lessons & optional extension.

2) Success criteria (suggested; editable)
   - Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for 1–2kb prompts under tested batch sizes.
   - Throughput: stable at your target QPS with <5% error rate.
   - Quality: automated eval set passes regression tolerance (delta <= 1.5% on core prompts).
   - Cost: per-token cost within agreed threshold (we’ll surface estimates after baseline run).

3) Integration highlights
   - SDK: we recommend using Redwood JS SDK for streaming; fallback to REST for server-side calls.
   - API routes: /v1/generate (sync), /v1/stream (websocket), /v1/tools/call (tool-calling orchestration).
   - Auth: short-lived API keys for trial, token rotation recommended.

4) Ownership
   - Redwood: Markus (trial lead / CS contact), Monica (SDK & integration eng), Karthik (infra / scaling / quantization advices).
   - ZephyrAI: Eleanor (product), Tom (eng lead), API/security contacts as needed.

Next step: propose a 45-min kickoff Wed/Thu morning PST to walk the checklist and assign immediate tasks. I’ll add a lightweight runbook to the checked-in checklist that lists sample payloads and expected responses.

Attaching initial artifacts; happy to adjust success thresholds once you share target QPS and sample prompts.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Eleanor Ruiz <eleanor.ruiz@zephyrai.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-17T09:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial ops playbook & API handshake for ZephyrAI POC

Eleanor / Markus — quick technical follow-up with the integration checklist excerpt (see attached file and gist link):

Integration checklist (concise):
- Sandbox & creds
  - Provide a sandbox dataset or sample payloads.
  - We’ll provision short-lived API keys scoped to the trial.
- SDK routes to wire
  - Client-side streaming: connect to wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1/stream with SDK helper (supports reconnect + resume).
  - Server-side generation: POST /v1/generate with JSON body {model, prompt, max_tokens, tools: []}.
  - Tool calling: POST /v1/tools/call — includes tool manifest and input mapping (we can provide a small manifest template).
- Auth & security
  - TLS required; we support mTLS on Private deployments but for hosted trial standard TLS + short-lived keys is sufficient.
  - Token rotation: we’ll provide an example script.
- Observability
  - Pass X-Request-Id header; we’ll echo for tracing.
  - We’ll provide a shared dashboard link for token-level latency / cost breakdown.

Blocked/ask from your eng team:
- Can they provide a sample of expected prompt sizes and typical concurrency?
- Any egress restrictions (VPC, IP allowlists)?

I’ll prepare a small sample payload bundle and post it to the gist for you to try against the sandbox.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Trial ops playbook & API handshake for ZephyrAI POC

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. Quick answers and a slightly revised success plan from our side:

ZephyrAI inputs:
- Typical prompt size: 800–1,800 characters (~250–550 tokens); peak concurrency expected ~12 concurrent sessions with bursts to 40 QPS.
- Egress: we can allow IPs from your hosted endpoints and will support an allowlist. No VPC peering needed for now.

Updated trial milestones (we prefer a tight 2-week trial with clear go / no-go gates):
- Day 0 (kickoff): creds + sandbox payloads.
- Day 2–5: SDK integration + streaming smoke tests.
- Day 6: Baseline latency tests (p50/p95).
- Day 8–10: Load run at 40 QPS (sample window).
- Day 12: Quality eval on regression set; review cost estimates.
- Day 14: Decision call (extend / purchase).

Success criteria (ZephyrAI):
- Latency: p95 < 600ms during steady load; p50 target < 200ms.
- Error rate: < 2% for valid requests.
- Quality: no >2% regression on our priority prompts.
- Cost: per-session incremental cost acceptable vs self-host baseline (we’ll share target numbers on Day 1).

Security question: we’ll have our security lead (security@zephyrai.com) validate the short SOC 2 checklist you mentioned. Please confirm token rotation and KMS integration options.

We’re good to schedule kickoff on Thursday 11/18 at 10am PST if that works for your team.

—Eleanor
